collectionMethod: Two maintainer screenshots of the same Allegretto account: (a) Kimi App usage analysis for K3.1 Pro over the last-7-days view (per-day token trend, model share of total usage); (b) the subscription page showing plan name Allegretto (赠送/gifted), validity to 2026-11-25, monthly total usage 1.92% (reset 2026-11-25 11:25), 5-hour Code 9.64% (reset 10-27 17:25), 7-day Code 9.61% (reset 11-02 11:25). Maintainer instruction: ignore the 5-hour figure, use the 7-day and monthly totals. Confirms the account tier left unconfirmed in kimi-v2-plans-round1-2026-10-26.json: it is a legacy v1 Allegretto (CNY 199 tier).
sources: Maintainer subscription-page screenshot 2026-10-27 (Allegretto gifted, valid to 2026-11-25; 5h/7d/monthly usage bars)

Maintainer Kimi App usage-analysis screenshot 2026-10-27 (K3.1 Pro: 37.4M tokens in last 7 days, 37% of all-model usage; 10/27 day burst 37,362,656 tokens = 36.7M cache-read + 548K input + 120K output; 99% cache hit, 224 calls)
data/research/kimi-v2-plans-round1-2026-10-26.json (earlier tile on the same account: 692,462,663 raw tokens = 63.24% -> 1.095B weekly pool)
scope: Absolute weekly and monthly Code-pool sizes on a confirmed legacy Allegretto (v1, CNY 199) account, measured in raw client tokens of a mixed-model, k3.1-pro-anchored sample.
adoptionStatus: adopted 2026-10-27: kimi_allegretto_cn x kimi-k3 monthly_yi 14.51 -> 19.46 (37,362,656 k3.1-pro raw tokens / console monthly 1.92%); cascades to kimi_moderato_cn (x4/20 -> 3.89), kimi_allegro_cn (x60/20 -> 58.38) and the v2 kimi-k3 half-rows (Plus 1.95 / Pro 9.73 / Max 29.19 / Ultra 58.38). kimi-k2.7-code rows unchanged (independent pure-model panel measurement). Prior basis 243,739,068/84% July k3-256k-mix sample superseded.

target.plan: Allegretto (legacy v1, CNY 199 tier; gifted subscription)

windows.fiveHourSlot: resets 2026-10-27 17:25 — excluded from the calc per maintainer instruction

appSevenDayView.singleVisibleDay: 2026-10-27 — the only bar in the 7-day trend

inputs.basis: maintainer clarified 2026-10-27 that the app page's '37% of total usage' refers to their TOTAL LOCAL usage and is unrelated to the kimi plan pool — so the pool-driving consumption is the k3.1-pro figure itself (the earlier all-model extrapolation to ~101M was dropped)

monthlyPoolRawTokens.formula: 37,362,656 / 1.92%; monthly consumption approximated by this same burst — app view shows essentially no usage before 10/27

calculation.poolRatioCheck: monthly / weekly = 5.005 — reproduces the Kimi monthly = 5 x weekly rule within display rounding, so both percentages carry the same consumption

discardedVariant.note: earlier draft divided the ~101M all-model total (37.36M / 37% share) by the tile percentages; dropped after the maintainer clarified the 37% share is their total local usage, not pool consumption

crossCheckVsEarlierTile.note: The earlier tile implies ~10.95B weekly — 2.8x this sample's 3.89B. Either the earlier account (tier then unconfirmed, now Allegretto) ran a much heavier mixed model, or its 692.5M included non-Code usage; the tile-percentage method is identical, so treat the earlier figure as a separate mixed sample, not corroboration.

possibleExplanations: k3.1-pro consumes fewer pool credits per raw token than the adopted sample's k3-256k-dominated mix — i.e. different model-equivalents.
The pool grew in the new-plan rollout (maintainer's own note: 'Kimi 的额度更新了').
This is a gifted (赠送) Allegretto whose quota could differ from a paid one.
comparisonToAdopted.note: The adopted row is a k3-256k-dominated July measurement; this is a k3.1-pro October measurement. Which K3 variant's credit rate k3.1-pro uses is not officially stated (K3 1M is officially 2x of k3-256k).

calculation.note: Pool sizes are in raw k3.1-pro client tokens, same raw basis as the repo's existing Kimi rows. If adopted for kimi-k3 it should record the model caveat like the current 14.51B note does.

whatWouldUpgradeThisSample: Per-model breakdown of the remaining 63% of the 7-day usage, so the pool can be denominated in a single model-equivalent.
Whether the 1.92% monthly figure contains any Kimi-chat (non-Code) usage — the monthly bar legend shows separate Kimi and Code segments and the visible segment is all Code-blue.
A paid (non-gifted) Allegretto panel to check whether 赠送 accounts share the same pool size.
confidence: medium-high for the pool arithmetic (two independent tiles agree, 5x ratio holds to 0.5%); low for mapping it onto the adopted k3 basis (model-equivalent unresolved)
redaction: Screenshots show plan name, validity date, usage bars and per-model token counts only; no name, avatar, e-mail or account ID.
